title: Worksheet / quiz
description: One file describes a printable worksheet or quiz. Every text field uses the markup described in docs/worksheet-format.md (bold, lists, $math$, [[box]] / [[line]] blanks).

title.description: Printed at the top of every page.

fields.description: Standard blanks shown in the header, in this order.

showGrade.description: Show a "Label: ____ / N" blank. N is the sum of the marks unless gradeTotal is set.

gradeTotal.description: Override for N. Leave out to add up the marks automatically.

repeat.description: Repeat the blanks (name, grade, ...) on every page. The title always repeats.

pageNumbers.description: "1 out of 3" at the bottom of each page.

defaultMarks.description: Marks for a question or part that does not set its own.

showMarks.description: Print "[2 marks]" next to each question.

handout.description: final: an answers page at the end of the student handout, counted in the page numbers.

key.description: A separate teacher key, printed as its own document. final: answers only. worked: each question with its worked solution and answer. both: the answers page, then the worked solutions. Default: final for quizzes, none for worksheets.

keyTitle.description: Title of the key: Teacher key, or Solutions when it is handed to students.

compact.description: No work space under questions or parts: students work on separate paper.

theme.description: How the pages look, not what they say: a built-in theme name plus any changed settings. Missing = Classic. See docs/worksheet-format.md.

templateOverrides.description: Text typed over by hand; wins over the rendered text. May use %name% placeholders.

partTemplate.description: This part of an unlinked question: its variables and hand-typed overrides.

space.description: Work space in lines (1 line is about 8 mm).

graph.description: A Cartesian plane and what is drawn on it, shown with the question or part. Shared format: see docs/graph-format.md (items marked key: true only appear in the teacher key).

generator.description: Which generator makes this question and with what settings, so it can be regenerated. Shared with the generator library: see docs/generator-api.md.

params.description: Real parameter values only; missing ones use the generator's defaults.

seed.description: Optional; without it the block uses "<document seed>/<block number>".

template.description: An unlinked generated question: rendered from values instead of a seed, so editing a value updates the answer and steps. Each part carries its own template { vars, overrides? }; a whole-question template has vars on the block. Shared with the generator library: see docs/generator-api.md, section 6.

params.description: Generator settings at unlink time (to pick more parts like these).

question.description: A question (numbered 1), 2), ... and marked) or a worked example (labelled EX1, EX2, ... and not marked).

label.description: Replaces the automatic number / EX label.

marks.description: Marks for the question; when it has parts or blank table cells, marks for EACH part / cell.

space.description: Work space under the question, or under each part when it has parts.

answer.description: Answer for the key (questions without parts).

solution.description: Worked solution, shown only in a worked teacher key. One step per line.

lined.description: Ruled lines in the work space, for written answers.

solution.description: Worked solution for the teacher key.

lined.description: Ruled lines for this part (overrides the question's lined).

rowLabels.description: Add an a), b), c) column.

oneOf.description: A cell students fill in. Counts as one part for marks.

src.description: Usually an embedded data: URL so the file is self-contained.

notes.description: A box for the student's own words: notes, a summary, a note to their future self. Not numbered or marked.

lines.description: Height in lines of work space.

lined.description: Ruled lines instead of blank space.
